scope: Public admission, registration, check-in and onsite access rules for official Fortnite physical events in France and Europe

principles.ticket_is_not_admission: A ticketing or preregistration state does not by itself prove that a person may enter a venue/session. Admission requirements are tracked separately.
principles.preregistration_is_interest_only_unless_: A generic preregistration/notify-me form is not treated as attendance registration and never guarantees admission unless the organizer explicitly says so.
principles.unknown_stays_unknown: Age, ID, named-ticket, guardian, re-entry, accessibility, queue, bag and check-in rules remain UNKNOWN until a direct authorized source publishes them.
principles.session_scope: Access rules may differ by day, session, zone or ticket category. A rule at one scope never propagates globally unless the source explicitly makes it event-wide.
principles.onsite_rules_are_not_scarcity: Security, queue, age or accessibility rules never imply ticket scarcity/capacity.
principles.capacity_guard: Capacity, quota and remaining inventory are stored only if explicitly published for the exact scope; never infer from venue size or a seat map.
principles.append_only_history: Material access changes are appended to history; corrections do not silently erase previous official instructions.

history.note: Generic EWC Paris preregistration was tracked as interest/notification registration only; it was not proof of admission or a Fortnite-specific ticket.
A previously followed EWC ticket page exposed paid Tournament Pass inventory for Boulevard City, Riyadh.

Current Fortnite Championship details and EWC relocation material place the event in Paris. The current EWC Paris form only offers notification preregistration, so paid admission is no longer asserted and onsite requirements remain UNKNOWN.
